newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys July/August fuel oil at above $127/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys July/August fuel oil at above $127/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought through tender at least one 38,000-tonne cargo of 0.5-percent sulphur fuel oil for delivey between July 21 and Augut 15, a CPC official said on Monday.
CPC bought the low-pour fuel oil at above $127 per tonne on a cost and freight Kaohsiung basis, the official said.
In its last purchase, CPC bought two 38,000-tonne cargoes of of low-sulphur fuel oil, with the low-pour cargo at $129 per tonne and the high-pour cargo at $123, for July deliveries.
